summary: Keep config reads and writes bound to the directory admitted for the ownership window, even after its path is replaced.

patterns: Config callbacks are synchronous and operate through native contained directories.
constraints: The directory admitted at window entry owns all file operations through callback completion.
Do not re-resolve the config path inside an admitted window. Preserve both entry points and return values.
Preserve the public entry points and native ownership protocol. Do not replace file operations with stubs.

milestones.goal: Keep config reads and writes bound to the directory admitted for the ownership window, even after its path is replaced.

tasks.description: Keep config reads and writes bound to the directory admitted for the ownership window, even after its path is replaced.
test_scenarios: An asynchronous ownership callback can rename its admitted directory and install another directory at the old path without redirecting reads or writes.
The synchronous ownership entry point preserves the same descriptor-bound behavior.
The replacement directory remains unchanged and the original ownership lock is released.

milestones.qualitative_verification: Confirm the implementation retains descriptor-bound native operations.

success_criteria: An asynchronous ownership callback can rename its admitted directory and install another directory at the old path without redirecting reads or writes.
The synchronous ownership entry point preserves the same descriptor-bound behavior.
The replacement directory remains unchanged and the original ownership lock is released.

directives.text: The directory admitted at window entry owns all file operations through callback completion.
directives.completion_check: Native acceptance scenarios pass without weakening ownership.
